cdn.preflight:
Managed WebAccel will, using the token you provide:
  - create a WebAccel resource for each of this site's domains (or adopt a
    matching one that already exists),
  - configure origin, host header, caching, and origin guard,
  - then ask you to add one DNS TXT record per domain to prove ownership,
    and route traffic through WebAccel once it is verified.

Mint a token at https://secure.sakura.ad.jp/cloud/#/apikeys
  Service access: SAKURA Web Accelerator (only)
  Permission:     can create and delete resources

Kamakiri never deletes resources unless explicitly asked to with the kamakiri cdn cleanup command.

cmd.usage_domain_add:
Usage: kamakiri domain add <domain> [--redirect [--status N] | --alias] [--no-wait]
  Blocks until the redirect/alias is live, streaming a go-live
  view (waiting → detected → live). Safe to Ctrl-C any time.
  The server keeps checking; resume with `kamakiri domain verify`.
  --no-wait  print the record + queue and return promptly
             (also the automatic behavior in non-TTY / CI).
cmd.usage_domain_register:
Usage: kamakiri domain register <domain> [--no-wait]
  Registers account-level ownership of a domain (no project required).
  Prints the TXT to publish, then blocks until verified, streaming the
  view. Safe to Ctrl-C any time; the server keeps checking.
  --no-wait  print the record and return promptly (also the automatic
             behavior in non-TTY / CI).
cmd.usage_domain_remove:
Usage: kamakiri domain remove <domain> [--no-wait]
  Blocks until the teardown is in sync on our side.
  Safe to Ctrl-C any time. Teardown continues server-side.
  --no-wait  queue and return promptly (also the automatic
             behavior in non-TTY / CI).
cmd.usage_domain_set:
Usage: kamakiri domain set <domain> [--no-wait]
  Blocks until the domain is live, streaming a go-live view
  (waiting → detected → live). Safe to Ctrl-C any time.
  The server keeps checking; resume with `kamakiri domain verify`.
  --no-wait  print the record + queue and return promptly
             (also the automatic behavior in non-TTY / CI).
cmd.usage_domain_unregister:
Usage: kamakiri domain unregister <domain>
  Removes account-level registration of a domain (no project required).
  Synchronous; fails if a site still uses a host under it (detach first).
cmd.usage_domain_unset:
Usage: kamakiri domain unset [--no-wait]
  --no-wait  exit 0 immediately after queueing.
             Without it, the command blocks for up to ~60s waiting
             for the edge to apply, and exits 1 with `still syncing`
             if the deadline is hit.
cmd.usage_domain_verify:
Usage: kamakiri domain verify <domain> [--no-wait]
  Re-checks your DNS now and blocks until the domain is live,
  streaming the view. Safe to Ctrl-C any time; the server keeps
  checking.
  --no-wait  open the check and print fresh status promptly
             (also the automatic behavior in non-TTY / CI).
cmd.usage_env_cdn:
KAMAKIRI_CDN_TOKEN, KAMAKIRI_CDN_SECRET
    WebAccel API credentials for `kamakiri cdn webaccel`. Prefer these
    over --token/--secret flags in CI: command-line arguments are visible
    in `ps`, while env vars are not.

dns.apex_options_advice:
Both options work. ALIAS/ANAME is slightly more convenient (CDN
    changes don't require DNS edits); A records work everywhere,
    including providers that don't support ALIAS/ANAME. If you don't
    know which your provider supports, A records are the safe choice.
